title: The Power of Connection
summary: The strongest ideas often emerge in the conversations between people...
body_markdown:
## ****By Jamie Handler, Vice President, Global Marketing****


The strongest ideas often emerge in the conversations between people, when different perspectives come together, questions are explored, and there is space to think beyond the obvious.


That is what made last week so meaningful. Our Global Marketing team came together from seven countries and four regions for our inaugural Global Marketing Summit, united by a shared theme: **EMERGE** . We challenged ourselves to emerge as individuals, as marketers and, most importantly, as one global team.


Our time together centered on three commitments: **CONNECTION. COLLABORATION. CONSISTENCY.**


Over two days, we explored our global portfolio, customer and market insights, our brand and the evolving role of social media. We also looked ahead to how artificial intelligence will change the way marketers understand audiences, develop ideas, and create value.


AI will undoubtedly influence how we work. But our conversations reinforced something equally important: **technology cannot replace the value of human connection, curiosity, and collaboration.**


Most notably, we elevated best practices across the regions to inspire creativity, accelerate growth and enhance customer engagement.


We left the Summit with stronger relationships, new ideas and renewed momentum. My hope is that everyone also left feeling more connected, inspired and confident in what we can accomplish together.


I am incredibly proud to lead this talented global team and inspired by the work they do every day to help Avanos advance healthcare for patients and clinicians.


Emerging as one team does not mean thinking alike. It means bringing different perspectives to the same table, listening to one another, and moving forward with shared purpose. That is the culture we are building, and I am excited about where it will take us next.
